title: UTIAS MR.CLAM Dataset 1
authors: Keith Y. K. Leung | Yoni Halpern | Timothy D. Barfoot | Hugh H. T. Liu
historical_status: Previously catalogued, Dataset 1 files verified this batch
version_or_sample: 17 data files from pinned mirror, compared across two mirrors
signals: 5 indoor ground robots, relative barcode observations indexed by observer, time and target, motion commands, Vicon poses
supported_analysis: directed observation counts and intervals, localization evaluation
limits: No packet transmit/receive timestamps or communication outcomes. Three unknown-barcode observations excluded from robot pairs.
data_rights: Official page requests citation. No explicit raw redistribution terms found.

title: Packet latency measurements in experimental TSN-capable networks
authors: Manuel Cheminod | Marc Ruiz Ramírez | Luis Velasco Esteban | Claudio Zunino
historical_status: New data release in G1 catalogue, verified this batch
version_or_sample: CORA/RDR Dataverse v1.0, complete set of 20 receiver reports and two method documents
signals: Fixed test bench, 2 UDP streams, 5 configurations and 2 repetitions
supported_analysis: transport delay at the documented clock layers, source-to-reception age proxy
limits: Wireless receive time includes interrupt/software delay. Application sample and consumer timestamps unavailable.
